def get_prob(x, n):
    common = x * (n - x) / (n * (n - 1))
    termA = 1.5 * common * (n - x - 1) / (n - 2)
    termB = 3.0 * common * (x - 1) / (n - 2)
    termC = 1.0 * x * (x - 1) * (x - 2) / (n * (n - 1) * (n - 2))
    return termA + termB + termC

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    p = float(data[1])
    x = 0
    while get_prob(x, n) < p:
        x += 1
    print(x)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
